candidates.title: Recover monthly active revenue index to ≥ 100
candidates.description: Headline recovery objective across all three phases of the MYDAWA Recovery Programme. Restores monthly active revenue to pre-incident baseline levels, demonstrating that the business has returned to stable revenue-generating capacity and that customer engagement initiatives have succeeded.
candidates.rationale: Directly cited as the headline measure in both the Recovery Plan and KPI Contract baseline documents.
candidates.evidence_citation: MYDAWA Recovery Programme — Strategic Plan: 'Headline measure: monthly active revenue index, baseline = 100, target ≥ 100 within 180 days.' KPI Contract: 'Headline number for the board: monthly_active

candidates.title: Restore weekly active sessions index to ≥ 95 (Phase 1)
candidates.description: Phase 1 exit gate: fix the checkout regression and restore weekly active session traffic to near-baseline levels. Success proves the technical root cause has been resolved and users are returning to the platform at pre-incident frequency.
candidates.rationale: Phase 1 exit gate explicitly defined in the Recovery Plan; also cited as a lead indicator in the KPI Contract.
candidates.evidence_citation: MYDAWA Recovery Programme — Strategic Plan: 'Phase 1: fix checkout regression and restore weekly active sessions to pre-incident baseline. Exit gate: weekly_active_sessions_index ≥ 95.' KPI Contract:

candidates.title: Restore monthly active revenue index to ≥ 95 (Phase 2)
candidates.description: Phase 2 milestone: re-engage lapsed customers through targeted reactivation campaigns and restore monthly active revenue to 95% of baseline. Demonstrates that proactive outreach has successfully recaptured a significant portion of churned revenue before moving to growth phase.
candidates.rationale: Phase 2 exit gate defined in the Recovery Plan baseline document.
candidates.evidence_citation: MYDAWA Recovery Programme — Strategic Plan: 'Phase 2: re-engage lapsed customers via targeted reactivation and restore monthly active revenue to ≥ 95% of baseline. Exit gate: revenue index ≥ 95.'

candidates.title: Achieve checkout conversion rate ≥ pre-incident mean
candidates.description: Lead indicator for Phase 1 success: restore the checkout funnel conversion percentage to its historical average, confirming that the technical regression has been fully remediated and the user purchase path is operating at baseline efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Cited as a lead indicator in the KPI Contract with an explicit target of returning to the pre-incident mean.
candidates.evidence_citation: KPI Contract — Eight Workstreams: 'checkout_conversion_pct (target ≥ pre-incident mean by Phase 1 end).'

candidates.title: Achieve reactivation email response rate ≥ 12% (Phase 2)
candidates.description: Phase 2 engagement metric: measure the success of targeted reactivation campaigns by tracking the percentage of lapsed customers who respond to re-engagement emails. A 12% response rate validates the campaign design and audience targeting strategy.
candidates.rationale: Specified as a lead indicator for Phase 2 in the KPI Contract baseline document.
candidates.evidence_citation: KPI Contract — Eight Workstreams: 'reactivation_email_response_pct (target ≥ 12% by Phase 2 end).'
